notes.title: Route 66 Simulator: The Free Ride - Demo Version
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Fans,

Today we have a great information for you as our game Prologue is participating in a Steam Next Fest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325860/Route_66_Simulator_The_Free_Ride/

Starting today you will all be able to test Demo version of our Prologue to see all the improvements we have made since our last Demo earlier this year. 

We can't wait to hear your opinions, so be sure to leave us feedback in the Discussion Tab on Steam or by using the form provided at the end of the Demo.

We hope you will have a great time and that we will see you on the road.
Also remember to add our Prologue version to your wishlist if you have not done so already


See you soon,
Grande Games

notes.title: Route 66 Simulator - Demo Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Fans,

We have watched you play and heard your feedback on our Steam Discussions Tab. Our team was hard at work these past two days making sure we fix all the bugs you guys encountered and also made some changes based on your feedback. You can read full Patch Notes below.

Patch Notes: 

- Prisoner Mission has been fixed and should no longer cause player to be unable to move his character.

- Graphics Options - Resolution changes now take place after hitting Accept button, not after each change of set resolution.

- Added an Autosave feature to the game.

- Jumping on car no longer causes player to bounce back.

- AI tweaks for thugs on Junkyard.

- Some minor tweaks in certain missions.

- Some minor UX changes to the Equipment Tab.


Thanks for your continuing support, feel free to leave us more suggestions if you have some and report to us any issues you may encounter during playthrough. Also remember to fill out the survey once you finish the Demo and add our game to your Steam Wishlist to not miss any upcoming Devlogs.

See you soon,

Grande Games.
